description: Virtual Test Bed, published by National Reactor Innovation Center / DOE NEAMS, collects documented example challenge problems for advanced nuclear-reactor simulation. Coverage: The repository contains multiple documented advanced-reactor challenge cases, each with its own geometry, physics and input assumptions. Source and documentation are publicly accessible through the repository; no model files were downloaded or executed. Licence: CC-BY-4.0, read from the repository's licence file on 2026-09-27; obtaining it is free of charge. The free cost label refers to repository access; external software or services can have separate costs. Limitations: Individual cases require their referenced simulation tools and access permissions. The repository is a case collection, not one universally executable reactor model. For catalogue screening, its documented functions support capacity planning, resilience studies; this is an assessment of possible use, not a claim of validated performance. Related records: No directly related catalogue record was established from the reviewed sources.
